resources.name: Brockville and Area Food Bank
resources.summary: Groceries for people in need, weekdays by appointment, with home delivery available on request.
resources.food_access_purpose: Groceries for people in need, weekdays by appointment, with home delivery available on request.

details: The provider asks visitors to call 613-342-0605 and leave a voicemail to make an appointment; home delivery can be requested the same way.
Intake closes at 2:45 p.m., and earlier on high-volume days so everyone already waiting is served.
Southeasthealthline asks visitors to bring ID and says income statements and heating, hydro and rent information may be required; the provider has not confirmed the details.
The building is wheelchair accessible, per southeasthealthline.

eligibility: Applicants are screened to determine eligibility based on income criteria, per southeasthealthline. Its service area names Augusta, Front of Yonge and Elizabethtown alongside Brockville; a March 2026 news report names Brockville, Lyn, Mallorytown and North Augusta.
limitations: A four to five day supply of food once a month, per southeasthealthline.
before_you_go: Call 613-342-0605 and leave a voicemail to book a visit or ask about home delivery.
Arrive before 2:45 p.m.; intake may close earlier on busy days.

schedule.note: Weekdays 10 a.m.–2:45 p.m., from the provider's own site. Intake closes at 2:45 p.m.

evidence.note: Provider contact page: 58 Buell Street; PO Box 522, Brockville, ON K6V 5V7; 613-342-0605. Open Monday to Friday 10 a.m. to 2:45 p.m. Intake closes at 2:45 p.m. and may close earlier at high volume. Appointments and home-delivery requests by voicemail.
Provider homepage restates Monday to Friday 10 a.m.–2:45 p.m. hours, address and phone.

Listing updated April 23, 2026: Mon–Fri 10 a.m.–2:45 p.m., arrive by 2:45 p.m. to complete intake. Fees: Free. Service: four to five day supply of food once a month. Application: bring ID; income statements, heating, hydro and rent information may be required. Eligibility: applicants are screened based on income criteria. Area served: Augusta, Front of Yonge, Elizabethtown (alongside Brockville). Wheelchair accessible. A fragment reading 'Open the 2nd & 4th Monday of the Month' conflicts with the provider's own weekday hours; the provider site controls. The postal code K6V 5V7 comes from this listing's address block.

Listing dated September 16, 2025. The page itself could not be re-read on 2026-10-08 (bot verification); a search-index extract shows Tuesday to Friday 10 a.m.–3 p.m. hours, which are superseded by the provider's current 10 a.m.–2:45 p.m. weekday hours.
